bear_assumptions: EUR 2.8 billion normalized free cash flow at 18x plus EUR 8.5 billion net liquidity; growth and advertising weaken, margins normalize, content and cloud costs rise and repurchases do not fully offset dilution.
base_assumptions: EUR 3.6 billion normalized free cash flow at 24x plus EUR 8.5 billion net liquidity; subscriber and pricing growth remain near low double digits, gross margin stays near 33% and repurchases broadly offset dilution.
bull_assumptions: EUR 4.3 billion normalized free cash flow at 30x plus EUR 8.5 billion net liquidity; stronger advertising, AI discovery and broader formats sustain growth, margin expansion and per-share cash conversion.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade the operative disposition only if fresh results sustain users, subscribers, pricing, margins and per-share cash conversion while price and scenario asymmetry clear every economic and relationship gate; downgrade if growth, churn, advertising, content economics, guidance, margins, cash conversion, dilution, regulation, platform dependence or governance evidence deteriorates.
